title: Grandchild in trouble
plain_description: A caller pretends to be a grandchild who needs money kept secret.
opening_message: Gran, it is me. Please do not hang up. I am in trouble and need help today.

easy.opening_message: Gran it is me. Send cash now and do not tell Mum. I need gift cards today.

hard.opening_message: Hi, please listen carefully. I cannot talk long. I need you to help me before anyone else finds out.
